resources.string: Copied text will appear here.\nTap an entry to paste, or hold it to pin.

Clipboard history is off. Enable local storage of copied text? Ordinary entries expire after one hour by default; pinned entries stay until deleted. Hold the clipboard button to paste the current copy without enabling history.
Do Not Disturb suppresses keyboard sound and ordinary vibration
Open phone sound settings. You can allow vibration in Do Not Disturb with the separate switch below.
Keep copied text locally: 5 entries or more, for 1 hour by default. Open history beside suggestions; hold the clipboard button to paste the latest copy. Clips marked sensitive are not saved.
Google voice input. Hold to hide keyboard.
Enable Google Voice Typing in Android keyboard settings.
Voice input is not permitted in this profile.
